audit_log_staff_identity_consistent.name: audit_log_staff_identity_consistent
audit_log_staff_identity_consistent.value: ("audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'staff' AND "audit_log"."staff_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."staff_identity" IS NOT NULL) OR ("audit_log"."actor_kind" <> 'staff' AND "audit_log"."staff_user_id" IS NULL AND "audit_log"."staff_identity" IS NULL)

audit_log_resource_target_valid.name: audit_log_resource_target_valid
audit_log_resource_target_valid.value: ("audit_log"."resource_type" = 'order' AND "audit_log"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."resource_id" = "audit_log"."order_id") OR ("audit_log"."resource_type" IN ('teacher', 'course', 'bookstore', 'book', 'course_book') AND "audit_log"."order_id" IS NULL)

order_lines_snapshot_kind_consistent.name: order_lines_snapshot_kind_consistent

orders_confirmation_pair.name: orders_confirmation_pair
orders_confirmation_pair.value: ("orders"."confirmation_token_hash" IS NULL AND "orders"."confirmation_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("orders"."confirmation_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."confirmation_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
